issue.title: [A+] ESLint: ban UI fetch, raw SQL, and @react-navigation app imports
issue.body:
## Summary / context

Part of the **A+ Architecture** gap (Now A− 8.7 → A+ ≥9.5). Layer boundaries are documented and mostly held by convention, but **not machine-enforced** in ESLint/CI.

## Current vs expected

**Current:** `eslint.config.js` does not ban `fetch(` / raw SQL in UI layers, or `@react-navigation/*` app imports. `scripts/architecture-guard.mjs` is warn-only and agent-only.

**Expected:** ESLint fails the existing `lint.yml` job when screens/components call `fetch`, embed SQL, or import `@react-navigation/*` directly.

## Scope

**In scope**
- `no-restricted-syntax` / import bans for `src/app/**`, `src/components/**` (and agreed UI paths)
- Ban `@react-navigation/*` imports outside allowed packages (Expo Router / `expo-router/drawer` only)
- Fixture or documented example proving a violation fails lint
- Short note in `docs/ci.md` or architecture docs pointing at the rules

**Out of scope**
- Wiring `architecture-guard.mjs` into CI (→ sibling A2 ticket)
- Removing `@react-navigation` packages from `package.json` (→ A3)
- Product feature work

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] ESLint fails on `fetch(` in UI layers
- [ ] ESLint fails on raw SQL / `getDatabase()` misuse patterns agreed in the PR (or equivalent ban list documented)
- [ ] ESLint fails on app-level `@react-navigation/*` imports
- [ ] Intentional violation in a test fixture or CI-documented check proves the rule fires
- [ ] `npm run lint` green on current tree (no false positives on legitimate code)
- [ ] Engineering-only — no Needs QA

## Verification / test plan

1. `npm run lint` (clean tree)
2. Temporarily introduce a forbidden import/`fetch` in a UI file → lint fails → revert
3. `npm run format:check` · `typecheck` · `npm test -- --ci` if config touches shared tooling

## Links

- Parent: A+ initiative (umbrella issue)
- Related: A2 (CI guard), A3 (dep audit)
- Refs: `.cursor/rules/architecture.mdc`, `eslint.config.js`
